1693.name: Bridge Kickover & Back Walkover Clinic | March 20th | $30
1693.description:
Bridge Kickover & Back Walkover Skill Focus Clinic

Join us for a focused training session designed to help gymnasts build the strength, flexibility, and confidence needed to master their bridge kickover and back walkover.

Athletes will work on proper bridge position, strong leg drive, shoulder push, controlled kickover mechanics, and safe, confident landings. Our coaches will break down technique step-by-step and provide drills that help gymnasts connect skills smoothly and improve overall floor performance.

This session is perfect for gymnasts who:

  • Are close to getting their kickover or walkover

  • Want to clean up form and alignment

  • Need more confidence transitioning from bridge to walkover

  • Are working toward connecting skills on floor

Spots are limited to ensure individual attention and quality corrections.

1554.name: Springbreak Camp | FULL DAY | Ages 4+ |March 16 - 20 | $70 per day
1554.description:
School’s Out Camp at Capital Gymnastics!

Full day - 9:00am - 3:00pm $70/ day

Ages: 4-12yrs


School's out and camp is in! Learn gymnastics skills, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Co-Ed Gymnastics/Ninja Camps. Campers will participate in structured rotations on vault, bars, beam, and floor, as well as open gym, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun.

What to Wear: Students may wear comfortable or athletic clothing, or a leotard. Leotards are available for purchase in our gift shop.

Please note the following guidelines:

  • Two-piece outfits that expose the midriff are not permitted.

  • Clothing with buckles, straps, zippers, or excess fabric (such as skirts or tutus) is not allowed.

  • Socks and shoes are not permitted inside the gym.

What to Bring:

Full day: Students should bring a snack, lunch and a water bottle. Water fountains are also available for use.

1555.description:
School’s Out Camp at Capital Gymnastics!

Full day - 9:00am - 3:00pm $70/ day

Ages: 4-12yrs


School's out and camp is in! Learn gymnastics skills, play exciting games, and make new friends at our Co-Ed Gymnastics/Ninja Camps. Campers will participate in structured rotations on vault, bars, beam, and floor, as well as open gym, crafts, and group activities with our skilled staff. No experience is required to join the fun.

What to Wear: Students may wear comfortable or athletic clothing, or a leotard. Leotards are available for purchase in our gift shop.

Please note the following guidelines:

  • Two-piece outfits that expose the midriff are not permitted.

  • Clothing with buckles, straps, zippers, or excess fabric (such as skirts or tutus) is not allowed.

  • Socks and shoes are not permitted inside the gym.

What to Bring:

Full day: Students should bring a snack, lunch and a water bottle. Water fountains are also available for use.

1629.name: Summer Camp | HALF DAY | Ages 4+ |WK1 May 26 - 29 |🌟 Team Spirit & Gym Games Week
1629.description:
🌟 Team Spirit & Gym Games Week

9:00 AM – 3:00 PM • $315 per week or $70 per day

Kick off summer with a week full of teamwork, laughter, and friendly competition! Campers will build confidence and connection through a variety of high-energy gym games designed to encourage teamwork, leadership, and fun.

🏆 Activities Include:

  • Parachute Challenges – colorful, cooperative games that build coordination and excitement

  • Team Relays & Obstacle Races – fun, fast-paced challenges across beams, trampolines, and mats

  • Capture the Flag & Floorball – active games that teach communication and strategy

  • Tumble Track Races – sprint, jump, and roll competitions with a twist

  • Gymnastics Mini-Games – skill stations on bars, beams, and floor for friendly points-based fun

  • Group Problem-Solving Games – work together to “unlock” challenges and earn rewards

🎉 Why Kids Love It

  • Builds teamwork, sportsmanship, and confidence

  • Keeps campers active while developing coordination and creativity

  • Led by our energetic Capital Gymnastics coaching team

📋 Details

  • Ages: 4 - 13yrs

  • Hours: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM

  • Pricing: $315 per week or $70 per drop in day

  • What to Bring: Snack, lunch, water bottle, comfortable athletic clothes, and a big smile!
